title: TRH2TQA: Table Recognition with Hierarchical Relationships to Table Question-Answering on Business Table Images
research_question: Can explicit recovery of hierarchical relationships in visually complex business tables improve question answering over table images?
methodology: TRH2TQA is a three-stage pipeline operating on business table images and natural-language questions. A table-recognition module first converts the image into structured HTML containing table structure and recognized text; a post-structure stage then derives headers and hierarchical relationships using predicted column spans and bounding boxes. The recovered table representation and hierarchy are supplied with the question to a table question-answering decoder, and the system is evaluated on the VQAonBD 2023 benchmark.

key_findings.finding: The proposed architecture explicitly separates visual table recognition, hierarchical relationship recovery, and table question answering.
Hierarchical relations are inferred after table recognition using information including predicted column spans and bounding boxes.
The intermediate representation is HTML containing recognized table structure and textual content rather than an unstructured visual embedding alone.
The authors report that TRH2TQA improves question-answering performance on the VQAonBD 2023 business-document benchmark.
The method is specifically motivated by hierarchical tables whose merged cells and indentation make ordinary flat table recognition insufficient.

limitations: The accessible HTML source contains the abstract rather than the complete paper, so detailed architectural and ablation claims could not be independently extracted from full text.
The accessible source describes the method specifically for business table images.
The accessible source names VQAonBD 2023 as the evaluation benchmark and does not establish generalization to other table-image domains.
The abstract does not provide sufficient evidence to characterize performance on non-hierarchical documents, spreadsheets with workbook-level semantics, or cross-document provenance tasks.
raw_claims: TRH2TQA targets question answering on business table images.
Its table-recognition stage converts a table image into HTML structure and text.
A post-processing stage identifies headers and hierarchical relationships.
Predicted column spans and bounding boxes are used during hierarchical relationship extraction.
The recovered table information is combined with a natural-language question before answer generation.
The paper reports improved question-answering performance on VQAonBD 2023.
Merged cells and indentation are identified as important difficulties in hierarchical tables.
